status.en: 7 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 42% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Fallujah.
status.nb: 7 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 42 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Fallujah.

summary.en: Iraqi forces have moved additional troops into Basra to prevent possible Iran-backed attacks on Kuwait. Erbil airport is reopening to European airlines as international flights gradually resume. Baghdad and Erbil have agreed to allow Nineveh villagers to return, while protesters in Kirkuk blocked the Erbil highway over generator fees. Australians are being held in Iraq on alleged ISIS links and could face the death penalty, and a blast hit the British embassy in Baghdad. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irakiske styrker har flyttet flere tropper inn i Basra for å forhindre mulige Iran-støttede angrep på Kuwait. Erbil flyplass åpner igjen for europeiske flyselskaper etter hvert som internasjonale flyvninger gradvis gjenopptas. Bagdad og Erbil har blitt enige om å la innbyggerne i Nineve vende tilbake, mens demonstranter i Kirkuk blokkerte Erbil-motorveien over avgifter for generatorer. Australske borgere holdes i Irak på påståtte IS-tilknytninger og kan risikere dødsstraff, og en eksplosjon rammet den britiske ambassaden i Bagdad. UCDP registrerte 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
